ai.summary: Devotees gathered at multiple ghats in Gorakhpur for Chhath Puja rituals on Sunday evening, with municipal officials monitoring sanitation and security arrangements.

facts.claim: Thousands of devotees gathered at riverbanks and water bodies across Gorakhpur on Sunday evening to offer ‘arghya’ to the setting sun on the third day of Chhath Puja.
facts.quote: Thousands of devotees gathered at riverbanks and water bodies across Gorakhpur on Sunday evening to offer ‘arghya’ to the setting sun on the third day of Chhath Puja.

facts.claim: Women observing the 36-hour fast offered prayers for the health and prosperity of their families amid devotional songs and chants.
facts.quote: Women observing the 36-hour fast offered prayers for the health and prosperity of their families amid devotional songs and chants.

facts.claim: The rituals began around 5.20 pm, with devotees offering milk, water and traditional offerings, including fruits, sugarcane and thekua.
facts.quote: The rituals began around 5.20 pm, with devotees offering milk, water and traditional offerings, including fruits, sugarcane and thekua.

facts.claim: Municipal officials inspected the ghats to review sanitation, security and other arrangements.
facts.quote: Municipal officials inspected the ghats to review sanitation, security and other arrangements.

facts.claim: The Jal Kal department monitored facilities at hundreds of urban and rural locations, with water supplied to 105 temporary ponds through tankers and other equipment.
facts.quote: The Jal Kal department monitored facilities at hundreds of urban and rural locations, with water supplied to 105 temporary ponds through tankers and other equipment.

facts.claim: The Municipal Corporation appealed to devotees to avoid firecrackers, banned polythene and dumping Puja offerings into water bodies.
facts.quote: The Municipal Corporation appealed to devotees to avoid firecrackers, banned polythene and dumping Puja offerings into water bodies.
